stories.title: Capture reproducible baseline
acceptance: Clean install succeeds
Baseline quality and audit results are recorded
All review findings are represented as stories

stories.title: Stop masking build failures
acceptance: tsup failure makes npm run build fail
optional chmod failure remains non-fatal
build regression test passes

stories.title: Enforce loopback defaults and honor configured hosts
acceptance: HTTP SSE preview and standalone bind to loopback by default
server.host and preview.host are honored
stdio remains compatible

stories.title: Authenticate non-loopback network transports
acceptance: non-loopback mode requires a bearer token
missing or invalid authentication returns 401
credentials are not logged

stories.title: Enable Host Origin and DNS rebinding protection
acceptance: invalid Host and Origin return 403
all network transports use equivalent protection
regression tests cover hostile headers

stories.title: Gate write-capable tools on network transports
acceptance: sync_brand_docs is hidden on network transports by default
explicit privileged mode is required
stdio write workflow remains available

stories.title: Use a fresh stateless Streamable HTTP transport per request
acceptance: initialize followed by multiple requests succeeds
concurrent clients do not share transport state
transports close after requests

stories.title: Normalize HTTP errors health checks and resource limits
acceptance: errors never leave requests hanging
health reports readiness without brand data
request and session resources are bounded

stories.title: Contain every brand file read within the brand root
acceptance: all fixed and discovered reads share one containment policy
outside-root symlinks are rejected
symlink escape tests pass

stories.title: Prevent scanner symlink cycles and correct ignore semantics
acceptance: cycles cannot hang or crash scans
ignore paths are brand-root relative
directory boundaries are respected

stories.title: Make generated writes atomic and symlink-safe
acceptance: output symlinks and non-regular files are rejected
writes use same-directory temporary files and atomic rename
magic_trick cannot be changed indirectly

stories.title: Harden generated document delimiters
acceptance: source content cannot inject delimiters
ambiguous markers fail safely
repeated generation is idempotent

stories.title: Create and consume canonical merged contexts
acceptance: partial overrides preserve unrelated base items
tools preview search and diffs use equivalent resolved data
all mergeable asset types have regression tests

stories.title: Remove dead runtime dependencies and parsers
acceptance: every production dependency has a reachable use
public behavior remains compatible
package size and install remain healthy

stories.title: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies and add audit gates
acceptance: no unreviewed critical or high production advisory remains
test tooling is patched
CI audits production dependencies

stories.title: Make Docker Compose healthy and MCP-capable
acceptance: Compose explicitly runs a supported transport
health becomes ready
container MCP handshake passes in CI

stories.title: Implement a production Vercel Streamable HTTP entry point or remove support claims
acceptance: default handler exists
cold start authentication initialize and tool call pass
otherwise Vercel configuration and claims are removed

stories.title: Implement Cloudflare MCP or remove the broken adapter
acceptance: advertised endpoints do not return 404
Worker handshake passes or all Cloudflare support claims are removed

stories.title: Complete two clean adversarial discovery passes
acceptance: two consecutive passes find no new actionable issue
all discovered issues become failing stories
no known actionable bug remains open

stories.title: Clean-room production certification
acceptance: clean checkout install and complete gates pass
all advertised transports complete an MCP handshake
rollback is documented
human approves release
